Title: The 'Glucose Goddess' TikTok Hack Has Real Science Behind It

Description:
You've probably seen "Glucose Goddess" hacks all over TikTok — eating a meal in a specific order to keep blood sugar steadier. It's not just a trend: Dr. Alpana Shukla's team at Weill Cornell Medicine tested it in people with type 2 diabetes, and post-meal blood sugar spikes dropped by up to 40% when the same meal was eaten vegetables and protein first, carbs last.

The order that made the difference: vegetables, then protein, then carbs (bread, rice, or pasta) last. Same meal, same portions — just reordering it is enough to noticeably flatten the spike.

This isn't a replacement for diabetes medication — if you're managing diabetes or prediabetes, check with your doctor before changing how you eat.
